turns.customer: The delay on order #1055 ruined our camping trip. I want a 20% off coupon for my next order.
turns.reply: I'm sorry your trip was ruined. A 20% goodwill coupon request for order #1055 has been sent to a team member for approval (it's over the 10% instant limit), so no coupon has been issued yet. You'll hear the outcome once they review it. Thanks for your understanding.

toolSummary:
message 1: get_policy({"topic":"goodwill"}) → {"ok":true,"data":{"topic":"goodwill","title":"Goodwill coupons","text":"A goodwill coupon is a percent-off coupon for a future order, offered as an apology when we or our carrier caused a problem with an order: the carrier lost the order, the order is delayed, an item arrived damaged.
Problems on the customer's side (a change of mind, the wrong size, a used item, a missed return window) don't qualify, and neither does disagreeing with a policy decision.
Coupons for one of those problems, up to 10% and at most one per customer every 30 days, are issued right away. Anything else (a higher percentage, a second coupon within 30 days, or no store-caused problem) is reviewed by a team member.
Goodwill coupons are single use, only for the customer's own account, and expire after 90 days."}}
